display_name: HoloUtopia Integrated 3D World Runtime + First-Person Usability
intent: Render a living AI city with autonomous Town Focus and a first-person walk mode inside isolated towns, preserving NPC schedule memory, runtime_state persistence, centered camera pivots, and clean drop-in behavior without full-city NPC overhead.

robot_marker.notes: Tiny humanoid line people; no circles, no labels, no collision; activity reps use pose variation.

citizen_runtime.task_queue_source: data/database/utopia/tasks + authored schedules + virtual residential population + district activity representatives

person_marker.notes: Tiny humanoid line people; no circles, no labels, no collision; activity reps use pose variation.

activity_visuals.purpose: Make Simulation Hub activity readable with pods, plinths, terminals, standing slots, and distinct tiny-person poses.

citizen_runtime.world_atlas_style: city_world_atlas_style.py + district skyline landmarks + central hub clarity + district surface motifs + skyway ribbons + citizen dialogue bubbles
citizen_runtime.district_surface_motifs: low collisionless district-themed plaza glyphs; not roads or traffic lane markings
citizen_runtime.atlas_skyway_ribbons: elevated visual-only neon ribbons linking selected districts to Central Simulation/Core

citizen_dialogue.notes: Pass 50: citizens can answer what a service is doing from runtime service-operation state; speech remains nearby-only, brief, capped, non-overlapping, and same-day non-repeating.

citizen_runtime.service_operation_glyphs: tiny collisionless visual-only glyphs above service citizens; not labels and not speech bubbles
citizen_runtime.adventure_hero_status_bars: visual-only HP bars above the four active Core Ring hero slots
citizen_runtime.adventure_enemy_spawn_pulses: visual-only wave spawn pulses on the Core Ring perimeter
citizen_runtime.adventure_final_scoreboard: visual-only final result board with score, grade, survivor and queue bonus lines
citizen_runtime.notes: Pass 58: citizen simulation refresh is slightly less aggressive to protect frame pacing while preserving visible civilian visits and schedule state.

controls.notes: Pass 54: standalone camera now supports RMB drag look, mouse-wheel zoom, diagonal-normalized WASD movement, precision/fast modifiers, selected-target focus, view cycling, and one-key panel close.
controls.movement: Overview/Town Focus uses WASD to pan pivot; first-person uses WASD to walk, Shift jog, RMB mouse look, and E interact.
controls.escape_behavior: ESC closes active inspectors first; in first-person it returns to Town Focus, then returns to overview, then exits standalone app.
controls.town_focus_select: mouse1 on a district/building in overview enters Town Focus; mouse1 inside focus prioritizes local event diamonds, activity clusters, flow trails, then buildings/citizens. The quick guide updates to match selection context.
controls.town_focus_follow: click a route trail or citizen inside Town Focus to follow that citizen camera-side while the shared schedule clock keeps driving next destinations
controls.town_focus_detail_panel: right-side Town Watcher panel shows selected event/cluster/flow/citizen details and a compact local event feed
controls.town_focus_persistence: Town Focus NPC memory, event memory, selected local detail, follow target, and watcher orders are saved to a small runtime_state JSON file so focus/overview transitions and relaunches can restore context without editing authored schedules.
controls.town_focus_event_resolution: After selecting an event and pressing 1-4, the Watcher panel shows pressure, response status, and improving/stabilized outcomes as city time advances.
controls.town_focus_district_consequences: Town Focus watcher outcomes now affect runtime town status, mood, pressure, supply, safety, morale, productivity, and glitch-risk readouts without mutating authored schedules.
controls.town_focus_tilt_shift_camera: Entering Town Focus uses a tight isolated-town tilt-shift camera; Enter/P switches into first-person walk mode and ESC restores the same Town Focus view.
controls.town_focus_health_report: Town Focus summary now shows daily health grade, trend, next suggested watcher step, and runtime-only saved report memory.
controls.tutorial_panel: Contextual quick guide explains overview selection, Town Focus object inspection, event orders 1-4, follow camera, ESC return, and camera orbit/zoom controls without mutating simulation state.
controls.first_person_walk_mode: Inside Town Focus, press Enter/P to walk the isolated town in first person. WASD walks, RMB looks, Shift jogs, E interacts with citizens/events/buildings/routes, and ESC returns to Town Focus without resetting local sim state.

safety.unload_method: removeNode on overlay root and citizens root

panels.notes: Panels are DirectGUI read-only inspectors. Click a building or robot civilian to open readable game-facing info. Building panels now show Overview, Status, People, and Activity. Selected buildings also show a compact bottom-right site card with state, priority, risk, and civic value. Drag title bar to move; dock buttons keep the center gameplay view clear; Close or Shift+X closes. Raw IDs are hidden unless debug_raw_ids is enabled. Pass 54 controls: use X or ESC to close focused panels; F focuses the selected building/citizen; H hides the compact controls legend.

runtime_flags.town_focus_event_resolution: runtime_state event_outcomes derived from player orders and city clock

pass_51a_notes.name: Adventure Simulation Queue Foundation
pass_51a_notes.central_hub_click_rule: Hub can be observed only when adventure_simulation.observe_available is true.
pass_51a_notes.dead_player_replacement_policy: queued citizens replace dead players in later combat pass
pass_51a_notes.safe_scope: queue/status only; no combat dimension, no player control, no routing changes

features: town_focus_local_events: Focused towns generate district-specific clickable local events and watcher influence orders from clusters, flows, town identity, and shared city clock without mutating authored schedules.

town_focus_persistent_state: Focused town NPC memory, local event memory, follow target, selected detail, and watcher influence orders autosave to runtime_state JSON without changing authored schedules.
town_focus_event_resolution: Watcher orders now create pressure/outcome state for local events; focused towns show responding, improving, and stabilized results without mutating authored schedules.
runtime_notes: Pass 51B: Adventure simulation now appears as an embedded Core Ring bubble around the Central Core pyramid; defeated citizen players respawn at hub pads and queue replacements keep four active slots.

Pass 51C: Core Ring adventure combat prototype is active inside the Central Hub bubble with tiny enemies, hero action ticks, live score, deaths, replacements, and hub respawns; no external routing or collision changes.
Pass 54: Standalone controls now feel more like a playable game camera while preserving the existing click-to-inspect city systems.
Pass 55: District buildings now get color-shifted windows, facade skins, and roof accents based on district identity so the city reads more like a game and less like a flat debug mockup.
Pass 56: Buildings now have stronger district-specific roof silhouettes, tiny entrance portals/landing glows, and a safe visual-only facade pulse so the city feels more alive from game cameras.

Pass 57: Civilians can temporarily visit districts outside their normal home/work/social loop using read-only visit rules; frame metadata includes civic_visits and per-citizen visit_reason/visit_destination.
Pass 58: Frame pacing improved by batching glow updates, reducing tiny facade panel density, and skipping city runtime work while hidden.
Pass 59: Full city is now a cheap overview; Town Focus Mode hides non-focused district roots, shows local citizens from deterministic schedule frames, and restores the overview camera when exiting.

Pass 60: Focused towns now show local activity/event clusters and next-destination trails. Runtime stores session memory for each visible NPC position, current node, and next scheduled destination so leaving and re-entering remains connected to the shared city clock.
Pass 63: Town Focus selected events can now receive watcher priority nudges without changing authored schedules.

Pass 62: Town Focus Mode now creates district-specific local event diamonds such as market rushes, repair calls, checkpoint delays, research gatherings, harbor deliveries, residential social hours, and quarantine warnings. Events are deterministic from the town, day, clock bucket, activity clusters, and flow trails; they are clickable and session-memorized only at runtime.

Pass 64: Town Focus now has runtime persistent state. NPC memory, local events, selected detail/follow target, and watcher orders are restored from database/utopia/runtime_state/town_focus_session_state.json when available; authored schedules remain the source of truth.

Pass 65: Town Focus events now resolve over time after watcher orders. Event pressure, response progress, improving/stabilized outcomes, and town pressure summaries are derived from runtime orders plus the shared city clock; authored schedules remain read-only.

Pass 76: A compact contextual quick guide explains the playable loop: click a town, inspect diamonds/routes/citizens/buildings, press 1-4 on selected events, follow citizens, and return to overview. F1/Shift+H toggles it; authored schedules remain read-only.

Pass 79: First-person walk mode is available inside Town Focus only. It reuses the current Town Focus local sim and inspectors, stores lightweight player camera state in runtime_state, and avoids full-city NPC simulation.

performance.notes: Pass 58: facade pulse color updates are cached and batched; representative window grids replace max-density facade panels; hidden city layers skip visual/simulation ticks.
performance.town_focus_life_flow: Only focused-town clusters and trails are rebuilt on citizen refresh ticks; full-city overview keeps them removed.
performance.town_focus_local_events: Local event diamonds are generated only in focused town mode and removed when returning to overview; event memory is small runtime session state.
performance.town_focus_persistent_state: Autosave is debounced and capped: up to 180 NPC memory rows, 120 event rows, and 90 player orders so state restore is cheap.
performance.town_focus_event_resolution: Event pressure/outcome state is derived only on focused-town refresh ticks and capped through persistent runtime_state event_outcomes.
performance.town_focus_health_report: Health reports are derived on focused-town refresh ticks only and capped in runtime_state memory.
performance.town_focus_first_person: First-person mode keeps only the selected town active; movement updates a small per-town player-state memory and reuses existing focused-town local visuals.

pass_notes.pass58: Performance frame-budget pass: caches facade pulse metadata, updates glow nodes in batches instead of every frame, slightly slows citizen sim refresh, skips ticks when hidden, and caps representative facade window density.
pass_notes.pass61: Focused towns now expose clickable local sim objects. Activity clusters explain what is happening, route trails explain who is traveling and why, and selecting a route/citizen activates a camera follow target without mutating authored schedules.
pass_notes.pass63: Town Focus player influence pass: selected event diamonds accept watcher orders with 1 Help, 2 Repair, 3 Calm, 4 Supplies; orders affect runtime event pressure/readout only and do not mutate schedules.
pass_notes.pass62: Focused towns now generate clickable local events and watcher influence orders from district identity, current clusters, route flow, and city-clock buckets. Events appear as diamond markers, feed entries, and Town Watcher detail panels while staying runtime-only/read-only.
pass_notes.pass64: Persistent Town Focus state pass: writes small runtime_state/town_focus_session_state.json snapshots for selected town, local NPC memory, event memory, follow target, selected detail, and watcher orders. This is runtime/session state only, not authored schedule mutation.
pass_notes.pass65: Town Focus event-resolution pass: watcher orders now produce response progress, event pressure percentages, improving/stabilized status, and town pressure summary lines while staying runtime-state only.
pass_notes.pass68: Town health / daily report pass: consequence metrics now generate runtime-only health grades, trend, next watcher step, in-world health badge, and saved daily report memory.
pass_notes.town_focus_camera_pivot_fov: Pass 72 locks default camera pivots to the city center in overview and to the town center in Town Focus, with lower FOV values and orbit-style rotate/zoom/pan controls.
pass_notes.pass76: Tutorial/controls pass: adds a small DirectGUI guide panel that changes between city overview, Town Focus, selected event, active order, route follow, citizen follow, cluster, and building contexts. It is visual-only and session-only.
pass_notes.pass79: First-person walk mode: a runtime-only walking camera inside the selected Town Focus area with per-town player position memory, crosshair interaction using the existing selection stack, and no full-city simulation overhead.

town_focus.npc_state_memory: Persistent runtime state records visible NPC current positions, current town/activity/node, next destination, event memory, selected local detail, and watcher orders across focus/overview transitions and relaunches; authored schedules remain read-only and continue to drive future positions.
town_focus.entry_behavior: mouse1 on overview town enters focus; mouse1 in focus inspects local clusters/routes first, then local buildings/citizens
town_focus.npc_session_memory: visible NPC current positions, active node, and next destination are cached in runtime memory across town focus enter/exit; authored schedules remain read-only and continue to be the source of truth
town_focus.event_visual_policy: activity clusters, route trails, and local event diamonds are drawn only inside focused town mode and removed when returning to the full city overview
town_focus.event_memory: runtime_state JSON memory of visible town events keyed by day, town, time bucket, and event label; restored on runtime install and capped for performance; no authored schedule or database mutation
town_focus.event_outcomes: runtime_state JSON memory of pressure/outcome state for focused-town events; derived from player orders, event severity, local cluster density, route flow, and shared city clock; no authored schedule mutation

camera.purpose: Show the whole isolated district first; later passes can tune per-town offsets without derailing gameplay work.

health_report.camera_policy: keep whole-town tilt-shift framing while the report is shown

performance.camera_policy: keep whole-town tilt-shift framing while reducing focus-mode rebuild overhead

tutorial_controls.purpose: Make the autonomous Town Focus gameplay loop readable without blocking the city camera or local sim.

first_person_walk_mode.movement: WASD walk, Shift jog, RMB look; slower inspection speeds, bounded to focused town area
first_person_walk_mode.interaction_stack: local events/clusters/routes first, then buildings, then citizens
first_person_walk_mode.camera_restore: ESC returns to Town Focus tilt-shift view with same selected town and local sim memory
first_person_walk_mode.camera: ground-level eye height; bad overhead saved positions are reset per town
first_person_walk_mode.crosshair_hint: bottom prompt reports nearby citizen/event/activity/building/open-space target without mutating selection

implementation_notes.town_focus_district_consequences: Runtime-only town_consequences are saved in runtime_state beside NPC/event/order/outcome memory; authored citizen schedules remain read-only.
implementation_notes.town_focus_camera_standard: Town Focus default framing now backs up and raises the camera based on town bounds for a whole-town tilt-shift/isometric view.
implementation_notes.industrial_power_plant_layout: Industrial Yard Alpha now uses fewer filler blocks plus electric plant details: transformer yards, relay tower, cooling tower, fusion core, thermal storage, turbine/generator halls, and power bus lines. Authored schedules remain read-only.
implementation_notes.town_focus_tutorial_controls: Pass 76 adds a compact contextual quick guide with F1/Shift+H toggle. It does not alter town schedules, runtime_state persistence, routing, collision, or camera pivot behavior.
implementation_notes.town_focus_qa_regression: Pass 77 keeps gameplay scope stable: no authored schedule mutation, no HoloVerse/HoloCore/artifact route edits, and no new visual clutter. QA coverage lives in smoke scripts/report outside the patch zip.
implementation_notes.town_focus_package_dropin_cleanup: Pass 78 is a packaging and handoff cleanup pass. It does not change authored schedules, routes, collision, HoloVerse, HoloCore, or artifact adapters. Runtime/session saves remain excluded from patch zips.

performance_notes.town_focus_consequences: Consequence metrics are derived during focused-town snapshot refresh only and capped to small runtime_state memory.
performance_notes.town_focus_performance_budget: Pass 71 caches local life snapshots by town/day/clock bucket/state revision, skips unchanged visual rebuilds, caps visible route trails, and avoids rewriting DirectGUI text when the selected detail text is unchanged.

notes.town_focus_health_report: Runtime-only town_health_reports are saved beside consequences, events, orders, and NPC memory; authored citizen schedules remain read-only.
notes.pass75: Save-state hardening pass: versioned runtime_state schema, corrupt/oversize fallback, bounded save payloads, backup rotation, and safe runtime-state reset without touching authored schedules.
notes.pass76: Tutorial controls pass: small contextual guide teaches the city overview -> Town Focus -> event/order/follow/return loop while staying visual-only and session-only.
notes.pass77: Town Focus QA/regression pass: syncs runtime Python id with bridge config and verifies all towns enter/exit Focus, camera pivots stay centered, overview signals restore, tutorial remains available, and runtime_state reloads safely.
notes.pass78: Package/drop-in cleanup pass: refreshed launch handoff, documented the current Town Focus loop, confirmed patch-only file boundaries, and kept runtime_state/log/cache artifacts out of deliverables.
notes.pass79: First-person walk mode scaffold: enter from Town Focus with Enter/P, walk the isolated town, use E to interact with citizens/events/buildings/routes, and return to tilt-shift focus without resetting NPC memory or authored schedules.

history: Pass 68: Town Focus now has a runtime-only town health daily report with grade, score, trend, next watcher step, and persistence beside existing NPC/event/order/consequence memory.

Pass 71: Town Focus performance budget caches snapshots, throttles visual rebuilds, caps local flow trails, and avoids redundant HUD text writes while preserving whole-town tilt-shift framing and read-only authored schedules.
Pass 72: Centered orbit-camera pivot pass for city overview and isolated Town Focus, with lower FOV and wheel zoom that keeps the pivot stable.
Pass 74: Industrial Yard Alpha removes non-schedule filler buildings and adds power-plant/substation/cooling/transmission visual language while preserving schedules, NPC refs, and Town Focus systems.
Pass 75: Town Focus runtime_state is versioned, size-bounded, atomically saved with backup rotation, and safely quarantines corrupt/oversize saves instead of breaking launch.

Pass 76: Contextual tutorial controls panel added; F1/Shift+H toggles guide, and guide updates for overview, focused town, selected event, active order, route/citizen follow, cluster, and building contexts.

Pass 77: QA/regression pass synced the Python DEFAULT_RUNTIME_ID to the bridge config and smoke-tested all Town Focus enter/exit, visibility, camera pivot, tutorial, order, and runtime_state restoration paths.
Pass 78: Package/drop-in cleanup pass updates the standalone README and handoff notes, syncs runtime id v54, and verifies clean patch-only deliverables with no runtime_state/log/cache artifacts.

Pass 79: Town Focus now supports first-person walk mode inside the isolated town. It remembers player position per town in runtime_state, uses E for existing citizen/event/building/route interactions, and exits back to tilt-shift focus without mutating authored schedules.

qa_regression.notes: Pass 78 keeps Pass 77 QA behavior intact and adds clean drop-in/handoff documentation plus patch artifact hygiene checks.

handoff_notes: Pass 80: First-person walk mode now spawns at ground-level eye height, discards old overhead saved player positions, shows crosshair target hints, prioritizes nearby citizens for E interactions, and slows movement for readable close inspection.
